yards.definition: Form of yard (plural): A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

ybore.definition: Form of bear (obsolete participle past): To endeavour to depress the price of, or prices in.

ye.definition: The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yelled.definition: Form of yell (participle past): To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yelling.definition: Form of yell (gerund participle present): To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yelping.definition: Form of yelp (gerund participle present): To utter an abrupt, high-pitched noise.

yen.definition: The unit of Japanese currency (symbol: ¥) since 1871, divided into 100 sen.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yin.definition: A principle in Chinese and related East Asian philosophies associated with dark, cool, female, etc. elements of the natural world.

yipping.definition: Form of yip (gerund participle present): to bark with a sharp, high-pitched voice.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youths.definition: Form of youth (plural): The quality or state of being young.

zany.definition: Unusual and awkward in a funny, comical manner; outlandish; clownish.

zeppelin.definition: Form of zeppelin: A type of large dirigible rigid airship of the early 20th century, built by the German Luftschiffbau Zeppelin and designed to carry passengers or bombs.

zombie.definition: A person, usually undead, animated by unnatural forces (such as magic), with no soul or will of his or her own, typically being slow, obedient, and harmless unless directed to be harmful.

zombies.definition: Form of zombie (plural): A person, usually undead, animated by unnatural forces (such as magic), with no soul or will of his or her own, typically being slow, obedient, and harmless unless directed to be harmful.
